source.why_this_clip: A large frosted light bulb stands upright on its screw base in the centre of the frame, and the camera pulls back so the bulb shrinks and settles lower while rays of light begin to spread behind it. Before 12.0 s the bulb is static and a cartoon man moves beside it, and the only cut is at 20.75 s, so this 2 s pull-back is the bulb's own motion.
